source: Current CLASS2/C2_ICON/PASSIVE_ART. Illustrations do not simulate damage.

innate.name: Kindled Palms
innate.d: Fight bare-handed with short palm flames. Hold attack for a wider flame fan. Every third basic hit deals 25% extra damage.

cap.name: Master of Flame
cap.d: Deal 12% more damage and reduce skill cooldowns by 8%.

a.d: Fire a fast bolt for 2.2 times flame damage.

b.d: Fire three flames, each dealing 1.1 times flame damage.

a.d: Deal 10% more damage with attacks and skills.

b.d: Basic attacks are 12% faster.

a.d: Blast nearby enemies for 1.3 times damage and push them back.

b.d: Gain a shield worth 25% of maximum health for 5 seconds.

a.d: Take 10% less damage from all attacks.

b.d: Skills cost 15% less mana.

a.d: Fire a piercing flame for 3 times flame damage.

b.d: Strike nearby enemies for 2.4 times flame damage.

a.d: Defeating an enemy restores 3% of maximum health.

b.d: Skill cooldowns are 10% shorter.

a.d: Burn nearby foes once per second for 4 seconds. Each pulse deals flame damage.

b.d: Strike your aimed enemy and nearby foes for 4 times flame damage.

a.d: Deal 12% more damage with attacks and skills.

b.d: Defeating an enemy restores 8 mana.

innate.name: Battle Ready
innate.d: Every third basic hit on the same enemy briefly staggers it. Switching targets restarts the count.

cap.name: Unbroken Champion
cap.d: Gain +10% damage, +10% attack speed, and 15% damage reduction. Casting a skill restores 2% max HP.

a.d: A quick sweep hits nearby enemies. Short cooldown and low damage per cast.

b.d: Drive forward for 1.7x damage, stun the first target, and briefly brace.

a.d: Basic attacks deal 20% more damage.

b.d: Attack 10% faster. Every fourth basic hit deals 25% more damage.

a.d: Rush through enemies for 1.6x damage and stun them.

b.d: A full-circle sweep deals 2.2 times weapon damage to nearby enemies.

a.d: Dropping below 35% HP restores 12% max HP once every 30s.

b.d: Take 18% less damage while below half health.

a.d: Brace for 3s, reducing incoming damage by 60%.

b.d: Slam the ground for 1.5x damage and heavy knockback all around.

a.d: Defeating an enemy grants 12% more damage and 12% faster attacks for 6 seconds. Another kill refreshes the duration.

b.d: After dodging, gain 20% damage reduction for 2s.

a.d: Draw nearby enemies toward you for 6 seconds, helping protect your allies.

b.d: A crushing 4x strike that executes normal enemies below 20% HP.

a.d: Compatible weapons deal 10% more damage; skills cost 10% less mana. Stagger the same enemy every second basic hit instead of every third.

b.d: +15% knockback resistance and +8% damage reduction while moving.

innate.name: Clear Aim
innate.d: Avoid damage for 3 seconds to gain 10% damage and extra skill range until hit. Basic shots deal more damage at longer distances.

cap.name: Perfect Hunt
cap.d: Clear Aim becomes Perfect Aim: +3% more damage, survives a 0.75s grace after a hit, and a kill while active cuts skill cooldowns by 0.5s.

a.d: Fan of arrows — up to 5 enemies, 1.4x each. Applies your element once each.

b.d: One shot through a line — 2.2x first (−10% its armor), 1.5x rest.

a.d: Deal 12% more damage to enemies at least 7 metres away.

b.d: Basic hits push enemies within 4 metres farther away. Bosses resist the push.

a.d: Roll backward with brief invulnerability and fire a parting shot for 75% weapon damage.

b.d: Dash through a target (2.0x) and appear behind it; tap again within 1s to return.

a.d: After dodging or using a movement skill, take 15% less damage for 2 seconds.

b.d: After Tumble or Shadowstrike, your next basic hit within 3 seconds deals 20% more damage. Can trigger once every 6 seconds.

a.d: Place a trap for 5 seconds that repeatedly damages and slows enemies inside.

b.d: Become briefly invulnerable and slow nearby enemies with smoke.

a.d: After 3 seconds without taking damage, your damage bonus rises from 10% to 18%.

b.d: Your 10% damage bonus activates after 2 seconds without taking damage instead of 3.

a.d: Mark one enemy: you deal +18% and +10% crit to it for 8s.

b.d: Mark up to 5 enemies — they explode for 1.8x on death.

a.d: Deal 12% more damage while using an elemental weapon.

b.d: Marked enemies deal −8% to you; killing one heals 4% HP and gives +10% gold.

innate.name: Arcane Attunement
innate.d: Basic hits spend 6 mana for 35% extra damage while keeping 25% of your mana in reserve. Magic basic hits restore 2 extra mana, at most once every 0.65 seconds.

cap.name: Archmage
cap.d: +12% magic damage, +10% cooldown reduction, and every third skill refunds half its mana cost.

a.d: Fire a quick elemental bolt. Short cooldown and low damage per cast.

b.d: Fire a piercing elemental lance for 2x damage through every target.

a.d: Empowered basic hits deal 55% extra damage instead of 35%, for the same 6 mana. Magic skills deal 12% more damage.

b.d: Skills cost 15% less mana.

a.d: Teleport forward and become untouchable during the displacement.

b.d: Detonate a 1.4x freezing burst that slows nearby enemies.

a.d: Below half health, skills cost 40% less mana.

b.d: Casting a skill grants a shield equal to 4% max HP for 3s.

a.d: Create an implosion that pulls enemies inward and deals 1.3x damage.

b.d: Create a shield that absorbs 35% of max HP.

a.d: Basic hits empowered by spending 6 mana also apply your weapon element.

b.d: After standing still for 1.5 seconds, skills you cast have 15% shorter cooldowns. Moving ends the bonus.

a.d: Create a damaging storm for 4 seconds. For 10 seconds, your skills cycle through different elements. Your equipped weapon stays unchanged.

b.d: Release a massive 3.4x elemental explosion around your target.

a.d: Every fourth skill repeats for free. The repeat deals 35% of its normal damage; other effects keep their normal strength.

b.d: +30% mana regeneration and +10 maximum mana.

innate.name: Soul Hunger
innate.d: Your scythe drains health. Defeating an enemy restores 2 mana.

cap.name: Avatar of Death
cap.d: +12% damage and lifesteal. Killing a marked or corrupted enemy reduces every cooldown by 0.75s.

a.d: A quick scythe sweep damages nearby enemies and restores health when it hits.

b.d: Send a spectral scythe wave outward for 2.1x damage.

a.d: Defeating an enemy makes your next skill cost no mana. Stores one free cast at a time.

b.d: Your damage-over-time marks last 20% longer.

a.d: Dash through shadow and become briefly untouchable.

b.d: Become spectral for 3s: faster movement and 65% damage reduction.

a.d: Collecting a kill grants a 3% max-HP shield for 5s.

b.d: After using mobility, gain +18% move speed for 2.5s.

a.d: Implode nearby enemies toward a central point and stagger them.

b.d: Bind enemies in front of you, rooting them for 2.5s.

a.d: Defeating an enemy while below half health restores 5% of your maximum health (at least 3 HP).

b.d: Enemies affected by your void weapon effect move 18% slower.

a.d: A powerful draining sweep damages nearby enemies and heals 5% of your maximum health per enemy damaged. Healing is halved against players.

b.d: Create a persistent soul storm that damages and corrupts enemies.

a.d: Your void weapon effect builds 25% faster. When a charged attack or skill bursts a fully affected target, the burst deals 15% more damage and spreads the effect to nearby enemies.

b.d: Hitting an elite or boss restores 1 mana, at most once every 0.75 seconds. Defeating an elite restores 8% max HP.

innate.name: Holy Warrior
innate.d: Your first basic-hit target takes 15% extra basic damage. While it lives, other enemies deal 33% less damage to you. Holy weapons heal 2% of health removed (1% against players).

cap.name: Avatar of Light
cap.d: Take 18% less damage and deal +10% damage. Holy weapons heal an extra 1% of health removed (0.5% against players).

a.d: Drive forward for 1.7x damage, stun the first foe, and brace behind your shield.

b.d: Call a holy thunderbolt down on the toughest enemy nearby, with a holy splash — great against bosses and elites.

a.d: Ignore an incoming hit after 5 seconds without being hit.

b.d: Skills deal double damage to the first enemy you hit in a fight, until that enemy dies.

a.d: Pull nearby foes to you and brace behind a shield.

b.d: Scorch every foe around you with holy light for 2.2x damage.

a.d: Dropping below 35% HP heals you for 12% max HP (every 30s).

b.d: Defeating the first enemy you hit in a fight spreads fire to nearby enemies.

a.d: Raise a holy shield that absorbs up to 50% of your max HP. Briefly plant your feet (0.3s); dodge to cancel the stance.

b.d: A radiant burst: damage and slow every nearby foe.

a.d: Damage you block is returned to whoever dealt it.

b.d: Casting a skill restores 4% of your maximum health.

a.d: Brace for 4 seconds, reducing incoming damage and reflecting nearby hits. Immediately restore 15% of your maximum health.

b.d: Call a pillar of light down: heavy damage and knockback all around you.

a.d: Take 15% less damage while below half HP.

b.d: Your basic attack can select your first target before it hits, immediately granting your protection from other enemies.

innate.name: Death's Embrace
innate.d: Kills restore 3 mana and leave bodies for Raise the Dead. Every fifth basic hit also creates a body, even if the enemy survives.

cap.name: Lich
cap.d: +12% damage. Your Summon Skeletons and Army of the Dead minions never expire, and you may keep more of them at once.

a.d: Raise a pack of skeletons that hunt down nearby enemies.

b.d: Rapid-fire bolts of necrotic plague (~2s, softer each).

a.d: Summon one extra skeleton and your minions hit 20% harder.

b.d: Your own attacks and skills deal 12% more damage.

a.d: Raise your most recently slain nearby enemy as an undead ally.

b.d: Detonate a burst of bone shards that slows nearby enemies.

a.d: Each minion attack restores 0.6% of your maximum health (at least 1 HP).

b.d: Defeating an enemy poisons nearby enemies. The poison refreshes instead of stacking without limit.

a.d: Raise a shield of bone that absorbs up to 35% of your max HP. Briefly plant your feet (0.3s); dodge to cancel the stance.

b.d: A skeletal grip implodes enemies inward and deals damage.

a.d: Take 12% less damage. A lethal hit sacrifices one of your minions to save you, if one is available.

b.d: Kills restore an extra 8% of your max mana.

a.d: Raise a whole undead host at once to overwhelm the field. Briefly plant your feet (0.3s); dodge to cancel the stance.

b.d: A storm of decay rages around you for 4s.

a.d: Keep 6 more minions. Newly summoned minions deal 25% more damage.

b.d: Your own attacks and skills deal 20% more damage to poisoned enemies.

innate.name: Killer Instinct
innate.d: Stand still for 1 second to prepare a basic hit that teleports behind its target and deals 50% extra damage. Each automatic evasion adds 9% damage, up to 45%, for 5 seconds; another evasion refreshes it.

cap.name: Phantom
cap.d: +12% damage, +10% attack speed, take 12% less damage, and evade even more often.

a.d: Blink to the nearest enemy and strike for heavy damage.

b.d: Fire three back-to-back shotgun bursts of stars — shreds packs of enemies.

a.d: Stand still for only 0.5 seconds instead of 1 to prepare your next basic hit: teleport behind the target and deal 50% extra damage.

b.d: After standing still for 1 second, your next basic hit finishes a normal enemy below one-third health. Bosses and players take 25% extra damage instead.

a.d: Dash through shadow and become briefly untouchable.

b.d: Vanish in smoke (briefly invulnerable) and slow nearby foes.

a.d: Gain 12 percentage points of automatic evasion and take 10% less damage.

b.d: A kill with your prepared teleporting basic hit immediately prepares another, without needing to stand still.

a.d: Mark a target: it takes extra damage from you.

b.d: Hurl one massive shuriken that pierces straight through — huge single-target damage for bosses.

a.d: +8% dodge chance and take 10% less damage — slip through crowds.

b.d: +10% damage — your cuts run deep.

a.d: Deal 35% more damage and attack 30% faster for 6 seconds.

b.d: Become invulnerable for 4 seconds and prepare your next teleporting basic hit immediately.

a.d: Take 18% less damage while below half health.

b.d: +12% damage.

innate.name: Bloodrage
innate.d: Basic damage increases as health falls, up to 85% extra near zero health. Below half health, all damage increases another 15%.

a.d: Spend 10% of your maximum health to sweep nearby enemies for 2.6 times weapon damage. Cannot be used if the cost would leave you below 2 HP.

b.d: Strike nearby enemies for 2.2 times weapon damage and stun them for 2.2 seconds. On a hit, spend 6% maximum health and pause for 0.5 seconds.

a.d: Take 12% less damage and resist enemy knockback. You can still dodge.

b.d: Each kill grants 4% more damage, up to 20%. The bonus ends after 6 seconds without a kill.

a.d: Rush forward, damaging and stunning in your path.

b.d: Slam the ground for damage and heavy knockback.

a.d: Survive a lethal hit at 1 HP. Rearms after 5 seconds without taking damage.

b.d: Each kill restores 4% of your maximum health.

a.d: Sweep all nearby enemies for 2.2 times weapon damage.

b.d: A brutal strike that finishes low-HP foes.

a.d: Basic attacks deal 50% more damage while below half health. Healing still works.

b.d: Attack faster as health falls, up to 50% faster near zero health.

a.d: Deal 35% more damage and attack 30% faster for 6 seconds.

b.d: Raise a guard: heavy damage reduction and pull foes in.

a.d: Take 20% less damage while below half health.

b.d: Basic hits finish normal enemies below one-quarter health. Bosses and players take 25% extra damage below that threshold.

innate.name: Plunder
innate.d: Without an equipped weapon, fire your built-in pistol with basic attacks and swing your saber with a charged attack. Their damage grows with class rank and player level.

a.d: Rapid piercing pistol shots (~2s, softer each) — a gunslinger's rhythm.

b.d: A spread of shots across your front.

a.d: Basic attacks deal 15% more damage, including your built-in pistol.

b.d: Attack 15% faster with any compatible weapon, including your built-in pistol.

a.d: Dash to a foe and strike hard.

b.d: Roll back with a parting shot and snare.

a.d: Take 12% less damage.

b.d: Move 12% faster, with any compatible weapon.

a.d: Vanish in smoke and slow nearby foes.

b.d: For 12s, every kill drops gold straight into your purse — and a killstreak stacks the payout higher and higher. The pirate's farming tool.

a.d: Dodge cooldown is 20% shorter.

b.d: Earn 25% more gold from defeated enemies and other gold rewards. Selling items is unchanged.

a.d: Mark foes — they explode on death.

b.d: Drop a trap that damages and snares.

a.d: Deal 20% more damage to enemies below half health.

b.d: Deal 12% more damage with any compatible weapon. You do not need to hoard gold.

innate.name: Time Attunement
innate.d: Magic weapons deal 8% more damage; skills have 5% shorter cooldowns; kills restore 4 mana. Once per area, a lethal hit rewinds you to your position and health from 3 seconds earlier.

a.d: Rapid-fire bolts of temporal energy (~2s, softer each).

b.d: A piercing lance through every foe.

a.d: When a lethal hit triggers your automatic rewind, also restore the mana you had 3 seconds earlier, if it was higher.

b.d: Skills have 10% shorter cooldowns. Your automatic death-saving rewind also refreshes every skill.

a.d: A burst that slows nearby foes.

b.d: Teleport forward with brief invulnerability. Your automatic death-saving rewind is a separate class ability.

a.d: Take 12% less damage. After your automatic death-saving rewind, become invulnerable for 3 seconds instead of 1.2.

b.d: Your automatic rewind can save you from death twice per area instead of once.

a.d: Implode foes inward and deal damage.

b.d: A shield that absorbs up to 35% of your max HP.

a.d: All skills have 10% shorter cooldowns.

b.d: Deal 20% more damage to slowed enemies.

a.d: Stop enemies for 3 seconds. In PvP, slow opponents by 25% for up to 1.5 seconds instead of freezing their controls.

b.d: A massive temporal explosion.

a.d: Your latest skill repeats for free after 3 seconds. Casting another skill before then replaces the pending repeat.

b.d: Your skill hits slow enemies for 1.5 seconds. Bosses may resist slowing.

innate.name: Focus
innate.d: Fists deal 15% more damage and attack 15% faster. Each hit builds 6% extra damage, up to 30%, ending after 4 seconds without a hit. Basic hits also shorten your remaining dodge cooldown by 0.35 seconds.

cap.name: Grandmaster
cap.d: +12% damage, +10% attack speed, and your temporary damage bonus can build to 42% instead of 30% (56% with Focused Mind).

a.d: Deliver rapid punches. Each connecting hit builds your temporary damage bonus.

b.d: Dash in with a heavy palm that staggers the first foe.

a.d: Take 12% less damage while your dodge is ready.

b.d: Dodging restores 5 mana.

a.d: A parry stance: for a moment take almost nothing and throw blows straight back.

b.d: Roll aside with brief i-frames and a parting strike.

a.d: Each basic hit removes 0.7 seconds from your remaining dodge cooldown instead of 0.35.

b.d: Each hit builds 8% extra damage instead of 6%, up to 40% (56% at rank 10). The bonus ends after 5 seconds without a hit instead of 4.

a.d: A spinning kick that strikes everything around you.

b.d: A shockwave palm that dazes and slows nearby foes.

a.d: Restore 1.2% of your maximum health each second.

b.d: The first strike after a dodge hits for triple.

a.d: For 6 seconds, standing still reflects double incoming damage back to attackers. You still take damage.

b.d: A soaring kick that erupts on impact, blasting everything around.

a.d: After standing still for 1.5 seconds, restore 2% of your maximum health each second until you move.

b.d: Every fourth hit within your temporary damage-bonus window also strikes nearby enemies. Waiting more than 4 seconds between hits breaks the chain (5 with Focused Mind).

innate.name: Static Charge
innate.d: Basic hits send lightning to a nearby enemy for 34% damage. Each hit adds 3% attack speed and 2.5% move speed, up to 15% and 12.5%; bonuses end after 4 seconds without a hit.

cap.name: Storm Lord
cap.d: +12% damage, +10% cooldown reduction, and your lightning arcs to more enemies.

a.d: Fire a quick lightning bolt with a short cooldown.

b.d: A piercing bolt through every foe in a line.

a.d: Lightning from basic hits deals 50% damage to the nearby enemy instead of 34%.

b.d: Your lightning arcs to a third enemy as well as a second.

a.d: Blink in a crack of lightning, briefly untouchable.

b.d: A shock burst that slows nearby foes.

a.d: Each hit grants 4.5% attack speed and 4% move speed, up to 22.5% and 20%. Bonuses end after 4 seconds without a hit.

b.d: Casting a skill grants a shield worth 4% of your maximum health for at least 3 seconds. Repeated casts refresh it, not add shields.

a.d: A crackling orb that pulls foes in and zaps them.

b.d: A shield that absorbs up to 35% of your max HP.

a.d: Your chain jumps twice as far between targets.

b.d: Lightning from basic hits deals 50% more damage to secondary enemies.

a.d: Link nearby enemies for 8 seconds. Hitting one also damages the others.

b.d: A massive electric explosion around your target.

a.d: Lightning from basic hits briefly stuns secondary enemies for 0.4 seconds. Bosses and players are excluded.

b.d: When no secondary enemy is in range, lightning strikes your original target for an extra 34% damage.

innate.name: Dark Bargain
innate.d: Magic weapons deal +12% damage. Every skill sacrifices 3% max HP, but the sacrifice can never defeat you. Power always has a price.

cap.name: Dark Ascension
cap.d: +12% damage. Dark Bargain costs only 1.5% max HP, and defeating a cursed foe cuts every skill cooldown by 1 second.

a.d: Fire a fast void bolt that pierces one extra foe.

b.d: Hurl a heavy crimson lance through every foe in a line.

a.d: Deal 15% more damage. Maximum health is unchanged.

b.d: Casting a skill grants a shield worth 4% of your maximum health for at least 3 seconds. Repeated casts refresh it, not add shields.

a.d: Mark nearby foes for 7 seconds. Your damage against them is increased.

b.d: Damage the strongest nearby foe. Heal for 22% of health removed, or 11% against players. Blocked hits do not heal.

a.d: Cursed enemies take 30% extra damage from you instead of 15%.

b.d: Casting a skill grants +12% move speed for 2.5 seconds.

a.d: Blink forward and detonate shadow at your starting point and destination.

b.d: Collapse a slow void orb on your target, damaging and pulling nearby foes.

a.d: Deal +18% damage while below half HP.

b.d: Skills sacrifice 35% less health. Does not reduce the separate health cost of basic attacks or Blood Offering.

a.d: Spend half your current health to deal that much damage to every nearby enemy. Normal skill health cost also applies.

b.d: Condemn the strongest nearby foe with a massive delayed shadow blast.

a.d: Defeating a cursed foe restores 5% max HP and 6 mana.

b.d: Below 30% HP, gain 15% damage reduction.

innate.name: Born to Fly
innate.d: Ranged weapons deal +10% damage. While airborne, you fall 20% slower and deal 10% more damage.

cap.name: Sky Master
cap.d: +12% damage. Using a skill in the air renews one air jump and briefly holds you aloft.

a.d: Sweep nearby enemies and launch high into the air.

b.d: Fire a fast wind spear that grows stronger while airborne.

a.d: Deal 15% more damage while airborne.

b.d: Take 15% less damage in the air and for 2 seconds after landing.

a.d: Dive forward. Your next landing damages nearby enemies.

b.d: Create a rising wind that damages foes and launches you upward.

a.d: Landing grants +15% move speed for 3 seconds.

b.d: Using a skill in the air grants a shield equal to 6% max HP.

a.d: Dash through the air, damaging every enemy in your path.

b.d: Call down five wind spears around your target.

a.d: Fall 45% slower instead of 20% slower.

b.d: Attacking while falling drives you down onto the target.

a.d: Drop like lightning. Your next landing creates a large shockwave.

b.d: Lift nearby normal enemies for 3.2 seconds and strike with a ring of wind blades.

a.d: An airborne kill restores one air jump and removes 1.5 seconds from your dodge cooldown.

b.d: Become invulnerable for 0.18 seconds after jumping.

innate.name: Perfect Timing
innate.d: Blade weapons deal 18% more damage. Parrying blocks a hit and empowers your next Riposte skill; only one empowered use can be saved at a time.

cap.name: Endless Dance
cap.d: +12% damage. A successful parry refreshes your second skill and grants one second of speed and damage protection.

a.d: Open a short parry window. A hit during it deals no damage and stores a Riposte.

b.d: Cut twice in a wide arc. The second cut pushes enemies back.

a.d: After a successful parry, Riposte hits for 4.4 times weapon damage instead of 3.3. Requires the Riposte skill.

b.d: Move 10% faster. Dodging through an enemy opens a 0.65-second parry window.

a.d: Lunge and slash. A stored Riposte greatly increases its damage and reach.

b.d: Dash through enemies and turn to face them for your next attack.

a.d: Parry windows last 0.2 seconds longer.

b.d: Attack 12% faster. A successful parry also lets you attack again immediately.

a.d: Open a parry window that releases a shockwave when it catches an attack.

b.d: Cut an X ahead of you and leave enemies briefly stunned.

a.d: A successful parry restores 5% max HP.

b.d: A successful parry grants 20% damage reduction for 3 seconds.

a.d: Prepare a parry for up to 3 seconds. The first incoming hit is blocked and prepares an empowered Riposte.

b.d: Hold a long parry stance. Catching a hit unleashes a massive counterattack.

a.d: Below 35% HP, dodge cooldown is 20% shorter.

b.d: Take 10% less damage from attackers within 6 metres.

innate.name: Bonded Companion
innate.d: Your companion gains +25% max HP and +15% damage or healing, and catches up quickly across climbs. Without an equipped pet, a spectral wolf answers your commands.

cap.name: One Pack
cap.d: +10% damage for you and your companion. Once per level, a lethal hit leaves your companion at 1 HP, briefly untargetable and shielded. Commands empower your next basic attack; basic attacks empower your companion.

a.d: Your companion lunges for 1.6x damage and briefly stuns.

b.d: You and your companion strike together; the target is marked for increased companion damage.

a.d: Your companion gains 25% more maximum health and deals 15% more damage.

b.d: Your companion moves 18% faster and attacks 18% more often. Commands have 12% shorter cooldowns.

a.d: For 4s your companion intercepts part of incoming damage and gains a shield.

b.d: You and your companion dash to opposite sides of the target with brief dodge protection.

a.d: Healing either partner also heals the other for 30% of that amount.

b.d: Basic attacks reduce all Beastmaster command cooldowns by 0.25s.

a.d: Restore 30% companion HP and 10% player HP over time.

b.d: A damaging roar slows nearby foes and turns their attention toward your companion.

a.d: Companion damage increases 20% against marked enemies, bosses, elites, and enemies below 35% health.

b.d: +20% companion healing and 12% damage reduction while it is below half HP.

a.d: Call a spectral herd through a wide lane, striking and knocking enemies aside.

b.d: For 8s your companion gains +35% damage/healing, +30% speed, and relentless pursuit.

a.d: Commands deal 15% more damage. Companion hits have a 28% chance to splash 35% damage onto nearby enemies.

b.d: Commands cost 15% less mana and have 12% shorter cooldowns. Casting one grants 10% move speed for 2 seconds.
